WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, sum(n.net_sales) m FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22 AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rpt AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22 AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT mine.fiscal_year, mine.store_id, round(m,2) m, round(c,2) c, round(m-c,2) diff FROM mine FULL JOIN rpt USING (fiscal_year, store_id) WHERE abs(coalesce(m,0)-coalesce(c,0))>1 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date>=d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900),
lfl AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, sum(n.net_sales) ns FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22 AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT cs.region,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN s.ns END),0) all_ty,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN s.ns END),0) all_ly,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.ns END),0) lfl_ty,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.ns END),0) lfl_ly,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.ns END)/sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.ns END)-1),2) lfl_pct,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN s.ns END)/sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN s.ns END)-1),2) all_pct
FROM sales s JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN lfl l ON l.store_id=s.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=s.fiscal_week
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY lfl_pct DESC

WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date>=d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900),
lfl AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, sum(n.net_sales) ns FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22 AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3),
agg AS (
  SELECT cs.region,
    sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN s.ns END) lfl_ty, sum(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN s.ns END) lfl_ly
  FROM sales s JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN lfl l ON l.store_id=s.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=s.fiscal_week GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lfl_ty/lfl_ly DESC) AS rank, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, region,
  ROUND(lfl_ty,2) AS lfl_net_sales_this_year, ROUND(lfl_ly,2) AS lfl_net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0*(lfl_ty/lfl_ly-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM agg ORDER BY rank
